title: sudo_relay berths among Recovery's machines
intention: sudo_relay's code, charter, records and proofs live at cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/, its instance home defaults to ~/.cairn/devices/recovery/0/machines/sudo_relay, its shortcut lives in its own bin/ (cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/bin/start, the long form `cairn recovery sudo_relay start`), and cairn/devices/cairn/bin/sudorelay calls that long form, so repo-root bin/ loses it (outline 5.4.3.7) and `cairn sudorelay` still starts it.
why: Measured 2026-11-24 on akiendelllinux (cairn dde12e2d0): outline 6.3.8 and 6.3.8.2 (cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/06-recovery-device.md:54-61) name sudo_relay a machine running as its own root process inside Recovery's boundary, and 2.3.2.1 lets a device own processes besides its own. On disk it is a top-level device at cairn/devices/sudo_relay/, beside cairn/devices/recovery/machines/{install_inspector,installer}; its instance home is ~/.cairn/devices/sudo_relay/0 (relay.py instance_dir) and its one code entry is bin/cmd/sudorelay (python3 -m cairn.devices.sudo_relay.daemon). Raised as outlinecheck's open-7e3abbb276d1 on affe403487b0, answered 'proceeds; placement is its own move ticket'. Recorded at ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/measurements/sudo-relay-placement-2026-11-24.md.
traces_to: Law 5 (intent and its code share an address, and the address is the outline's) and RULE 1 (Recovery's boundary is what holds its way to root).
how: After 1e62c1529f4c (the launcher's machine walk, outline 5.4.3.2) and affe403487b0 land. git mv the tracked files to cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/; the records (state, history, charter, validations) move through the artifact door (remove, then write at the new path). Imports become cairn.devices.recovery.machines.sudo_relay; relay.instance_dir() defaults to ~/.cairn/devices/recovery/0/machines/sudo_relay (CAIRN_SUDO_RELAY_DIR still overrides); the shortcut leaves repo-root bin/cmd/ (outline 5.4.3.7) for the machine's own bin/: cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/bin/start execs the new module with its argv (`cairn recovery sudo_relay start`, reached by 1e62c1529f4c's walk), and cairn/devices/cairn/bin/sudorelay calls `cairn recovery sudo_relay start "$@"` (outline 5.4.3.3: top-level shortcuts are the cairn device's bin/), so `cairn sudorelay` and `cairn sudorelay --status` are unchanged. bin/cmd/sudorelay is deleted. The prose mentions elsewhere (charters, comments, fixture strings) are not callers and stay. Reseal the moved proofs.

clauses.claim: cairn/devices/sudo_relay/ holds no tracked file, and cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/ holds relay.py, daemon.py, its charter and its four existing proofs

bin/cmd/sudorelay is absent; cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/bin/start runs python3 -m cairn.devices.recovery.machines.sudo_relay.daemon with its argv, and cairn/devices/cairn/bin/sudorelay calls `cairn recovery sudo_relay start`

decisions.text: D1: the component moves whole from cairn/devices/sudo_relay/ to cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/; records through the artifact door; imports and instance_dir follow.

D2: bin/cmd/sudorelay is deleted; cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/bin/start execs the new module; cairn/devices/cairn/bin/sudorelay calls the long form; address.py's example table names the new path.
D3: cairn/devices/recovery/machines/sudo_relay/proofs/test_sudo_relay_lives_inside_recovery.py, one PROVES key per clause.

out: moving the live audit folder ~/.cairn/devices/sudo_relay/0 and restarting the root daemon: a host-seam act with apply/verify, cast when this lands, since the restart is Akien's one privileged act
